v2_changes: group count sweep K in {17, 41} added to every group-based candidate before the first comparison run; K trades per-pixel state bytes (Gate 5 input) against grouped-contamination robustness

bimodal case excluded from the absolute vs-oracle bound and gated against truth instead: the production clip collapses to one mode by design when the weighted MAD is zero, so deviation from the oracle is documented, not failed
v3_changes: exploratory run showed all MoM candidates fail grouped_contamination_30pct at K=17 and winsorized still fails at K=41; at production N=600 periodic contamination spreads over every group, so a per-frame bounded candidate is required

candidate reservoir_sigma_clip added: deterministic hash reservoir keeps frame f iff splitmix64(frame_order ^ seed) < floor(2^64 * R / N) with R=64, seed fixed, where N is the known stream length (sampling-plan frame count, not the per-pixel valid count) so the keep decision is a true single-pass predicate; the exact oracle clip runs on the reservoir; for N <= R it is bit-identical to the oracle

cases clean_gauss_N600 and grouped_contamination_30pct_N600 added to measure the production-N regime; grouped_contamination_30pct_N600 is gated by the same worst-case vs-oracle bound, clean_gauss_N600 is reported (reservoir subsample noise) but not gated

context.input_stream: per native pixel and channel: ordered frame candidates (frame_order, x_f, b_f) folded per frame by the Gate-2 contract
context.oracle: production full-list iterative weighted median/MAD sigma-clip (robust_clip_core semantics: deterministic value order, weighted median, weighted MAD, asymmetric clip bounds, iterated passes, no epsilon padding)

hard_architecture_constraints.rationale: dense device scatter emits each frame-local A/B plane exactly once; a second pass over frame candidates would need either a pixel-times-frame store or re-rasterization, both forbidden

candidates.description: frames assigned deterministically to K=17 groups by frame_order mod K; group means weighted by group b; final value = weighted median of group means; weights b unchanged so B/B2 keep all frames

same K group means; center = median of group means, scale = 1.4826*MAD; group means clamped to center +- 4.5*scale; final = weighted mean of clamped group means with group b weights; frame weights unchanged
same K group means and same center/scale; groups outside bounds dropped entirely; final = weighted mean of surviving group means; B/B2 accumulate surviving group weights only

deterministic hash reservoir: keep frame f iff splitmix64(f ^ seed) < floor(2^64 * R / N), R=64, seed fixed, N = known stream length (sampling-plan frame count) so the keep predicate is single-pass; run the exact production oracle clip on the kept candidates; B/B2 accumulate the full stream so support is preserved and estimator_b = source_b; for N <= R bit-identical to the oracle
existing spike: frame-level winsorization at median(group means) +- 4.5*group MAD; needs replay of the frame stream
candidates.role: reference showing what frame-level winsorization would gain; fails the single-pass constraint

adversarial_matrix.model: frames 8 and 25 +50, sharing group 8 at K=17
even frames sigma 1, odd frames sigma 5
NaN x, b=0, b=-1, x=inf among clean

metrics: support_preserved: b > 0 whenever source candidates exist
deterministic repeat: identical inputs produce bit-identical results

thresholds.cosmic_ray_influence_bound: single-frame outlier of any finite magnitude shifts the estimate by at most abs(truth-shift of oracle) + 1e-6 relative to oracle value
thresholds.mad_zero_outlier_bound: with 39 identical values and one arbitrary finite outlier, estimate equals the common value exactly
thresholds.selection_rule: among selectable single-pass O(K) candidates choose the lowest worst-case absolute deviation from the oracle across the adversarial matrix; ties broken by lower max deviation from truth, then by simpler state machine

rules: no candidates with b>0 => no_source_support, all outputs zero
candidates < min_candidates => uniform fallback on all candidates
nonempty groups < min_groups => uniform fallback on all candidates
group MAD not positive finite => primary estimate = robust center with uniform weights (degenerate_scale)
every fallback preserves B>0 and finite value; robustness never deletes source support

deliverables: oracle implementation on materialized candidate list
deterministic adversarial matrix with assertions on all thresholds
decision JSON with selected primary estimator and parameters
estimator_b mapping for the Gate-2 fold contract
